questions.section: PART ONE: DIRECT QUESTIONS (20 Marks) – Please answer ONLY EIGHT QUESTIONS while question number 6&10 is COMPULSORY
questions.question: 1. List the Microsoft access database objects and discuss in detail two of them?
questions.answer_guide:
Objects: tables, queries, forms, reports (also macros and modules).
Tables store data in rows (records) and columns (fields). Queries search, filter, sort and combine data from one or more tables. Forms are used to enter, view and edit records. Reports present data in a formatted, printable way.

questions.section: PART ONE: DIRECT QUESTIONS (20 Marks) – Please answer ONLY EIGHT QUESTIONS while question number 6&10 is COMPULSORY
questions.question: 2. What is the Waterfall Model?
questions.answer_guide: A linear, sequential software development model in which each phase (requirements → design → implementation → testing → deployment → maintenance) must be completed before the next begins.

questions.section: PART ONE: DIRECT QUESTIONS (20 Marks) – Please answer ONLY EIGHT QUESTIONS while question number 6&10 is COMPULSORY
questions.question: 3. Explain in Brief the table basics
questions.answer_guide: A table stores data about one subject. Each row is a record and each column is a field with a name and data type; one field (primary key) uniquely identifies each record. Tables can be viewed in Datasheet view and Design view.

questions.section: PART ONE: DIRECT QUESTIONS (20 Marks) – Please answer ONLY EIGHT QUESTIONS while question number 6&10 is COMPULSORY
questions.question: 4. Identify the main advantages and disadvantages of database?
questions.answer_guide:
Advantages: reduced data redundancy, data consistency and integrity, easy sharing, better security, fast searching and reporting, backup and recovery.
Disadvantages: cost of software/hardware, complexity, need for trained staff, risk of total loss if the system fails, security threats.

questions.question: 7. How to add new record in a form?
questions.answer_guide: In Form view click the New (blank) record button on the navigation bar at the bottom (or Home tab → Records group → New), type the data into the fields, then save (Shift + Enter or move to another record).

questions.section: PART ONE: DIRECT QUESTIONS (20 Marks) – Please answer ONLY EIGHT QUESTIONS while question number 6&10 is COMPULSORY
questions.question: 8. What is reports?
questions.answer_guide: A report is a database object used to present (summarise and format) data from tables or queries in an organised, printable layout.

questions.section: PART ONE: DIRECT QUESTIONS (20 Marks) – Please answer ONLY EIGHT QUESTIONS while question number 6&10 is COMPULSORY
questions.question: 9. Explain the difference between interpreter and compiler?
questions.answer_guide: A compiler translates the whole program into machine code at once before running, producing an executable file. An interpreter translates and executes the program line by line, stopping at the first error.
